decisions.reason: The compact rotating dumper extends the established construction range at low carrying cost, still has its own page, and its uncertain upside justifies holding the option.
The articulated dumper fits the core offer, is still actively presented, and costs little to keep while market acceptance resolves.

Its fall from its own page to a mere mention signals weakening value in a distant niche, but it is a low-volume specialized vehicle that is cheap to carry, so the option is held a while longer despite elevated drop risk.
The multi-model telescopic loader line builds on core competence and is still prominently presented, so the option remains valuable and inexpensive to keep.
The material lift line is close to the core offer and has a proven rental market, as shown by a large order, so its value is largely realized.
Strong early field results of 1,000 operating hours in 7 months indicate the mining loader's option is resolving favorably and justifies further commitment.
